rapport_notes: Patient with the price pushback and explained the billing structure clearly, but didn't fully land the reassurance the customer needed.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "what are your biggest concerns or any important things that you're worried about that you wanted to answer on this call?" - asked immediately after the quid pro quo, before probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern about a glass bookcase; rep replied only "I'll take note of that then" and moved straight to address collection with no follow-up
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself... it will lessen the cost as well"

top_strength: Proactively logged the customer's fragile glass bookcase concern early, ensuring it carried through the entire logistics profile.
coaching_note: When the customer pushed back that 3 movers felt excessive for only 10 items, the rep defended the billing structure but never addressed the actual crew-size question - explaining the sizing logic directly would have been a stronger rebuttal.
